privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Throughput is a public, freely accessible portfolio demo of a fictitious B2B CRM/OMS product — not a real company serving real customers. This page explains, as required by Articles 13 and 14 of the GDPR, what personal data this demo processes, why, and what rights you have.

whoWeAre.heading: 1. Who is responsible for this demo
paragraphs: This demo is operated, for portfolio purposes, by [operator's legal name — placeholder, to be confirmed by the owner]. For any privacy question or request, contact [privacy@throughput.dbg.ro — placeholder, to be confirmed by the owner].

twoRoles.heading: 2. Two different roles under the GDPR
paragraphs: For your own account data (see below) the operator acts as data controller. For any CRM data you or another visitor enters into a shared demo workspace — company records, contacts, deals, orders, invoices — the operator only acts as a processor on behalf of whoever entered that data: it does not decide why that data was entered, and it does not offer a way for a third person named in that data to contact it directly (Art. 28(3)(e)).

whatWeProcess.heading: 3. What personal data this demo processes
whatWeProcess.intro: Only the following categories, all generated by using the application itself:
items: Workspace member accounts — name and email address, created when someone accepts a workspace invitation or resets a password. The four shared demo logins (Owner, Manager, Agent, Viewer) are pre-seeded fixtures, not personal accounts belonging to visitors.

CRM data entered into a shared demo workspace — company records, contacts (name, email, phone), deals, orders and invoices. Anyone with a demo login can enter or edit this data — see the warning in the next section.
Activity log — a record of who changed what and when, for changes made inside a workspace.

Functional cookies only — a session cookie, plus two preference cookies for interface theme and language. None of them are used for analytics, advertising or tracking, and no such tool is embedded in this site.

noRealData.heading: 4. Please do not enter real personal data
paragraphs: Demo logins are shared by every visitor until the next daily reset. Anything typed into a Contact, Account or similar form — a real name, a real email address, a real phone number — becomes visible to any other visitor who logs into the same demo account before that reset. Please use fictitious data only.

legalBasis.heading: 5. Legal basis
items: Workspace member accounts: performance of the arrangement that lets you use the demo (Art. 6(1)(b)), or the operator's legitimate interest in demonstrating the invitation flow (Art. 6(1)(f)).

CRM data entered by visitors: the operator's legitimate interest in letting the product be tried hands-on (Art. 6(1)(f)) — whether any data a visitor chooses to type in is appropriate remains that visitor's own responsibility.
Functional cookies: strictly necessary for the site to work, so no consent banner is shown (ePrivacy Art. 5(3)).

recipients.heading: 6. Who else sees this data
recipients.intro: The following subprocessors are used, each only for the purpose stated:
items: Stripe — processes the simulated subscription (test mode only, in this demo).
Shippo — generates shipping labels for orders (sandbox credentials only, in this demo).
Resend — delivers transactional email: password resets, workspace invitations, scheduled reports. In this demo, any address outside an internal allow-list is intercepted and never actually sent.
Sentry — error monitoring, hosted in the EU (Germany). Configured to not collect personal data by default, and to strip passwords, tokens and similar values before anything is sent.
recipients.transfers: Stripe, Shippo and Resend are US-based providers. The exact transfer safeguard used for each one — Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework — has not been documented for this demo [decision pending owner confirmation].

hosting.heading: 7. Hosting
paragraphs: The application runs on a self-managed virtual server (Coolify). Its exact hosting region has not been publicly documented for this demo [decision pending owner confirmation].

retention.heading: 8. How long data is kept
items: The entire application is rebuilt from its seed data every day at 03:00 UTC. Every account, workspace, contact and any other data entered by any visitor since the previous reset is discarded at that point, at the latest.
A GDPR data-export file (see "Your rights" below) is kept for 7 days after it is generated, then deleted; the request itself stays on record.

By design, the activity log keeps entries for 36 months, after which identifying details in older entries are replaced with a placeholder — though, in this demo, the daily reset above will normally erase everything well before that.
The log of transactional emails sent in demo mode is kept for 7 days.

rights.heading: 9. Your rights
rights.intro: Subject to the two-role split explained above, you can exercise:
items: Access and portability (Art. 15/20) — an Owner can request a full export of a workspace's data from Settings → Data export, prepared as a downloadable ZIP archive inside the application.
Rectification (Art. 16) — edit any record directly from the relevant screen.

Erasure (Art. 17) — a Contact can be deleted or anonymized from within the application; for any other erasure request, including a workspace member account, contact [privacy@throughput.dbg.ro — placeholder, to be confirmed by the owner].
Restriction and objection (Art. 18/21) — contact the same address.

Given the nature of this project — a public, reset-daily portfolio demo, not a live product with real customers — some of these requests may already be moot in practice: anything you entered is, at most, one day old before it is discarded.

complaint.heading: 10. Right to complain
paragraphs: You can lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority. In Romania, that is the Autoritatea Națională de Supraveghere a Prelucrării Datelor cu Caracter Personal (ANSPDCP), www.dataprotection.ro.

changes.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This page may be updated as the demo evolves; the date above reflects the latest revision.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms cover the use of this public demo only — they are not the terms of a commercial product.

nature.heading: 1. What this is
paragraphs: Throughput is a portfolio demo: a fictitious B2B CRM/OMS product, built to show working software rather than a company offering a real service. Nothing on this site is a commercial offer.

acceptableUse.heading: 2. Acceptable use
items: Do not enter real personal data belonging to yourself or anyone else — see the Privacy Policy, section 4.
Do not use the demo to store, transmit or generate unlawful, abusive or infringing content.
Do not attempt to bypass rate limits, security controls or the demo's operational safeguards, or to disrupt the service for other visitors.
Do not use automated tools to scrape, bulk-import or bulk-write data beyond normal, hands-on exploration of the product.

sharedAccounts.heading: 3. Shared accounts, daily reset
paragraphs: Demo logins are shared by every visitor, and any change you make — including anything you delete — stays visible to others until the next reset. The whole application is restored to its seeded starting state every day at 03:00 UTC; nothing you enter is guaranteed to persist beyond that.

noWarranty.heading: 4. No warranty, no liability
paragraphs: This demo is provided "as is", without any warranty of availability, accuracy or fitness for a particular purpose. To the fullest extent permitted by law, the operator is not liable for any damage arising from the use of, or inability to use, this demo.

intellectualProperty.heading: 5. Intellectual property
paragraphs: The source code, design and content of this demo are part of the operator's portfolio and remain their property, except for any third-party components used under their own licenses.

governingLaw.heading: 6. Governing law
paragraphs: The governing law and jurisdiction for these terms have not been documented for this demo [decision pending owner confirmation].

contact.heading: 7. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms can be sent to [privacy@throughput.dbg.ro — placeholder, to be confirmed by the owner].

changes.heading: 8. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: These terms may be updated as the demo evolves; the date above reflects the latest revision.
